chunks.text: LabQueue schedules shared lab equipment for university research groups.
40 students used LabQueue during a six-week pilot at Example University.
12 lab manager interviews informed the first prototype.
The team is two undergraduates and there is no faculty advisor.
No legal entity has been formed and there is no revenue.
The prototype runs on a single laboratory equipment calendar.
